title: Every rendered count equals what was rendered
statement: For each artifact-type total the project view prints, the number rendered on the page equals the number printed. Evaluated by counting rendered entries and comparing, for every type shown, with no tolerance.
notes: ⚠️ NO PARTIAL-FAILURE EXCEPTION, deliberately. AST-0035 measured the skeleton printing 178 while rendering 177 — the count is what turns an incomplete page into a misleading one, because an operator reading the total has been told the missing thing is present.
